selection: per validation object median (rank11/20) and highest wide-CD error; all methods use identical cases

config.dcd_coordinate_space: normalized visible-input coordinates; no radius rescaling

config.repulsion_method: exact nonself kNN; PU-Net energy, no ball-query padding

limitations: Selected examples, not random population samples. PCA uses target for display only. Ball boundary coverage is not a physical seam metric. Exact duplicate points may overlap in images. Models differ in parameter count; use wide CD for capacity comparison.
